en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a historic European town hall complex with gabled roofs and arcades. The main building has multiple windows with shutters, arched ground‑floor openings, and ivy climbing one wall. The scene is a quiet square with no visible people or vehicles. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small number is printed at the bottom right.
